meta.title: Where the warehouse count breaks
meta.subtitle: A yard supervisor walks an operations lead through a discrepancy that turns out to be a clock, not a thief.

abstract:
Two people spend an hour narrowing a stock discrepancy that had been read as theft. Bo Marek locates the gap at the receiving door rather than in the racks: a pallet is scanned on arrival and then waits on the apron, sometimes for two hours, before anyone assigns it a bin. For that wait the system claims custody of stock the floor cannot find.

A quarter of measurement puts roughly eighty per cent of the gap back within four hours, reframing loss as latency. Ada Sterling presses on the residual and Bo proposes a handheld that refuses to release a driver until a bin is assigned. The call ends without a decision on who funds the handhelds.

acts.title: The gap is at the door
acts.summary: Bo relocates the discrepancy from the racks to the receiving apron and describes the dwell window between scan and bin assignment.

turning_point.text: the count breaks at the door, not in the racks

acts.title: Latency, not loss
acts.summary: A quarter of measurement shows most of the gap closing on its own, which changes the category of the problem.

acts.title: The residual
acts.summary: Attention moves to the fifth of the gap that does not close, and to a handheld that would force a bin assignment.

turning_point.text: that is the number I would lead with

threads.name: Apron dwell
threads.what: The interval between a pallet being scanned at the door and being assigned a bin.
threads.why_it_matters: Every minute of dwell is stock the system owns and the floor cannot produce.

threads.name: Who funds the handhelds
threads.what: The proposed fix needs hardware nobody has budgeted.
threads.why_it_matters: The call ends on this and nothing is committed.

evidence.claim: About eighty per cent of the gap closes within four hours.
evidence.evidence: Bo cites a quarter of measurement in the yard.

evidence.claim: The discrepancy originates at the receiving door.
evidence.evidence: Stated directly and never contested across the call.

signals.signal: Ada reaches for the word 'shrinkage' and then drops it for the rest of the call.

numbers.means: Share of the counted gap that resolves without intervention inside four hours.

quotes.speaker: B
quotes.text: the count breaks at the door, not in the racks

quotes.speaker: A
quotes.text: so the discrepancy is a timing artefact rather than shrinkage?

tensions.note: The fix is named but not funded, and the call ends there.

diarization.why: Short overlapping acknowledgement at a turn boundary; attribution is the weakest here.

next_steps.commitment: Bo will price a handheld that blocks driver release until a bin is assigned.

aligned_on: The gap is latency at the receiving door.
Measurement over a quarter is the right basis.
unresolved: What happens to the residual twenty per cent.

risks.note: She may report the eighty per cent figure upward before the residual has an owner.
The fix he proposed depends on hardware his budget does not cover.
